mentions.name: GhanaHousePlanner
mentions.description: This web platform helps users plan, estimate, and manage house construction projects in Ghana and for the diaspora. Features include a live material price list updated monthly from local shop prices, conceptual 2D/3D floor plan generation following Ghana Building Standards via phased procedural generation, a construction management dashboard to track project stages and conversations between project manager, mason, carpenter, and others, and printable material cost breakdowns. Free for individuals; project management and the floor planner AI agent require a subscription. A contact listing for local construction services is planned.
mentions.audience: People in Ghana and the diaspora planning house construction projects; free for individuals
